summary: The junipernetworks.junos collection is deprecated and will be removed from Ansible 14 unless someone takes over maintenance.
questions: Is junipernetworks.junos being removed from Ansible?
When will the Junos collection be dropped from the Ansible package?

answer_card.title: junipernetworks.junos is deprecated
answer_card.answer_md: As of Ansible 12.3.0 the `junipernetworks.junos` collection is deprecated. It will be **removed from Ansible 14** unless someone starts maintaining it again before then, following the removal process for unmaintained collections.
